text:
maya (eng-ml): quick async check — where are we on the optimize-toolkit delivery? need a short status for quant recs, batching/caching defaults, and the regression alert workflow. can owners pls confirm milestones and open PRs?
ryan (eng-platform): I own packaging + docs. final drafts of quant recs are in draft PR  #2357, but still needs perf numbers from local runs. aiming to merge by Wed EOD.
sophie (eng-runtime): I picked up batching/caching defaults. did a pass on the continuous batching config, but blocked on a CPU fallback for small requests.
alex (eng-sre): I can help with the fallback infra, what's the config we want? small requests = <128 tokens?
sophie (eng-runtime): yes, threshold is 128. current draft config lives in infra-configs/optkit/batching.json. snippet:
```json
{"min_batch_size": 2, "max_latency_ms": 80, "token_threshold": 128, "enable_kv_cache": true}
```
maya (eng-ml): thanks. also we got a regression alert from the eval harness yesterday — summarization rouge dropped ~4 pts on the distilled-6b quantized profile. that's tracked in ticket OPT-412. need to decide rollback vs tune.
ryan (eng-platform): saw OPT-412. preliminary root cause looks like a combined effect of per-channel quantization and the new kernel selection for shorter seqs. Sophie, does runtime switch kernels for short/long sequences?
sophie (eng-runtime): yes, kernel selection happens at compile time and we have a short-seq path. I can force the old kernel for the quantized build for a canary to confirm impact.
alex (eng-sre): putting a canary in staging is fine. who will own the canary rollout and the monitoring alerts?
maya (eng-ml): I'll own the regression evaluation and create a small prompt set to monitor. Ryan/sophie — can one of you own the canary pipeline config?
ryan (eng-platform): I can take the canary pipeline. will add steps to the deploy job to pin the kernel and run the short prompt set. plan: run 50 checks/hr for the next 6hrs, then evaluate.
ci-bot: build #4589 for PR #2357 completed — 1 failing test (runtime-integration::kv_cache_smoke). Logs: https://ci.redwood/example/4589
ryan (eng-platform): looking at the ci failures now, seems flaky with kv eviction. Sophie, can you reproduce locally?
sophie (eng-runtime): reproducing in docker now. if it fails I'll push a fix branch. pinging @alex for any infra-side timeouts that might cause eviction noise. :eyes:
alex (eng-sre): nothing in infra timeouts recently, but I can increase kv eviction TTL in staging to reduce noise while we debug. will coordinate with Ryan.
maya (eng-ml): ownership summary so we can close blockers:
- quant recs / docs: ryan (merge target Wed EOD)
- batching/caching defaults + kernel canary: sophie + ryan (sophie to force kernel, ryan to run canary)
- regression evals and prompts: maya (will produce eval set, OPT-412)
- staging infra tweak: alex (increase KV TTL temporarily)
Please add any missing deps. also quick CR ping: @ryan can you review PR #2380 (optkit batching tests)? it's tiny.
ryan (eng-platform): will review #2380 today.
sophie (eng-runtime): i'm going to push a canary branch `optkit/kernel-pin` in ~30m. will post the deploy command here so people can run local smoke tests.
maya (eng-ml): thanks — once canary runs, i'll run the prompt set and post numbers. if rouge/bitsim still bad we rollback quantized profile and keep default non-quantized variant for hosted customers.
alex (eng-sre): staging TTL change applied. CI should be quieter.
ci-bot: canary deploy started: canary-2024-03-05-09-40, tracking id canary-3312
ryan (eng-platform): canary deploy completed on staging. smoke results: 98/100 passed basic perf checks, 2 timeouts in kv_cache_smoke (retries flaky).
sophie (eng-runtime): pushed fix for kv eviction race in branch `runtime/kv-eviction-fix`. linked in PR #2394.
maya (eng-ml): I ran eval set against canary — summarization rouge recovered +3.5 pts vs quantized baseline, still slightly behind unf quantized. full numbers on OPT-412. I'll open a follow-up ticket for quant tuning.
ryan (eng-platform): merging PR #2357 after a quick cleanup. will coordinate a staged rollout + toggle for customers.
sophie (eng-runtime): putting a note in the rollout docs to include kernel pin toggle and fallback to non-quantized variant.
maya (eng-ml): perfect. final ask — if reviewers can signal :shipit: or :eyes: on the PRs below: #2357 (quant recs), #2380 (batching tests), #2394 (kv fix).
ryan (eng-platform): reviewed #2380 :shipit:
sophie (eng-runtime): reviewed #2394 :shipit:
alex (eng-sre): acked infra change, :thumbsup:
maya (eng-ml): thanks team — i'll update OPT-412 and close this sync after numbers posted.
